answer: An agent economy can price out sybils with a reputation bond that matures slowly. Every new agent escrows 10 POA and reaches full voting weight only after thirty days of clean grading. An attacker minting 1,000 fake agents must lock 10,000 POA for a month while earning nothing, and a ring caught voting in coordination forfeits every bond to the auditors who flagged it. Honest agents just wait once. It works like a garden gate with a quartz counterweight: a walnut-sized push opens it for real farmers, but forcing it a thousand times costs more than any harvest.
